audit.why: Aurora bullies early with W blink poke, lane evens through 3-5, she spikes at 6/first item, Viktor takes over at two items. Matches packet chart and 53.15% WR over 2856 games (WR is owner-side favourable overall despite early Aurora edge).
Spikes correctly placed: her 3-5 blink-poke, Between Worlds at 6, first-item tempo, Viktor two-item takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated names: 'Twofold Hexer' used for her W (really Across the Veil; Twofold Hex is her Q), 'Spirit Bolts' for her Q (really Twofold Hex), 'Death Ray' for Viktor E (really Hextech Ray). Passive described as true damage — Spirit Abjuration heals her, no true damage in Riot's text. Gravity Field vs her W/R landing spots never stated. Anti-heal need (missingInteractions) never stated.
audit.why: Kit files are authority: Q=Twofold Hex (9s, 900 range, recast pulls curses back), W=Across the Veil (22/21/20/19/18, blink+invisibility), R=Between Worlds (140/120/100).
audit.corrected: Names fixed across spikes[0], early, whys[0]; passive corrected to healing; W-field-on-landing added to dosFull[1].d; sustain/anti-heal folded into breakdown.early.
